name: family-drawer
blurb: Multi-view drawer with smooth height transitions between views.
description: A FamilyDrawer using vaul and Framer Motion; supports multiple nested views with animated height transitions; view switching is smooth.
use_when: Creating multi-step flows, wizards, or nested drawers (e.g., Share → Copy Link or Send Email).
avoid_when: For single-view drawers — use directional-drawer instead to reduce complexity.
a11y: View switching is animated; Escape key closes drawer; focus management handled by vaul; keyboard navigation supported.
